features.feature: Create a Time Keeper project from an idea (form)
features.why: Created through the Studio form on an iPhone-sized screen; listed and reopened in a fresh desktop session (A1–A4).

features.feature: Time Keeper identity only; Diabetes History refused
features.why: Palette, themes, end card and voices come from the Time Keeper profile only; a Diabetes History profile and the DH voice are refused (UI check + unit tests).

features.feature: ElevenLabs final-voice profile selection
features.why: abdullah selected and recorded as needs_authorization: it is approved for Royal Oak only, so it cannot be used for this film without the owner. Nothing was generated.

features.feature: Saving, reopening, version history
features.why: Every change is an append-only event; reopening replays them; History lists every step; reopen after server restart tested.

features.feature: Historical research with reliable sources
features.why: Done by Claude with web sources (10 claims, 8 verified, 1 attributed, 1 avoid). The Studio stores, shows and ENFORCES the claims but cannot research by itself. rolex.com refused direct fetch (403); its text came through search summaries. The Daily Mail headline wording is unverified, so the film does not quote it.

features.feature: Arabic script writing
features.why: Written by Claude acting as the writer and posted through the API; the Studio has no writer. Versions, checks and decisions are the Studio's.

features.feature: Historical-claim check on the script
features.why: v1's 'Rolex made the world's first waterproof wristwatch' was caught as CLAIM_UNSUPPORTED and approval was refused; attributed wording («يقولون…») is allowed.

features.feature: Grammar and dialect review
features.why: No automatic grammar or dialect checker. A person can flag a word as Grammar or Dialect; nothing checks it by machine.

features.feature: Planted spelling mistake detected; highlight, explain, request correction
features.why: «فيلسدروف» flagged as SPELLING with the suggestion «فيلسدورف»; tapping the highlighted word opens the sheet pre-filled; the request is recorded with kind and note.

features.feature: Correction changes only that word; earlier versions kept
features.why: v4 differs from v3 by exactly that word (word diff); v1–v3 unchanged, read-only, still viewable; compare view shows the one change.

features.feature: 3–4 hooks with spoken line, on-screen text, opening visual
features.why: 4 hooks (written by Claude) each shown with the engine-rendered first frames at 0.0/0.5/2.0 s.

features.feature: Recommendation with reasons; selection recorded; payoff
features.why: Recommendation and reasons are the writer's (not computed). Selection made script v5 (still needing approval); the system proposed l13 as the payoff and the owner confirmed it.

features.feature: Narration-ready text + pronunciation dictionary
features.why: The approved script goes through the project's pronunciation library for the draft provider; the script itself is never edited.

features.feature: Free draft audio (clearly labelled)
features.why: gTTS (Time Keeper's draft provider), labelled DRAFT on every screen. Needs internet access to translate.google.com.

features.feature: Waveform, transcript, word timings
features.why: Per line: waveform, timed words (whisper word timestamps aligned to the script; unmatched words estimated and marked), machine transcript shown.

features.feature: Tap a word → hear it
features.why: Measured in the page: the tapped word (and its immediate neighbours at the edges) lights up and plays; the sheet confirms 'played'. Fixed during the test (it used to play from the start of the line).

features.feature: Flag a mispronounced word → correction → new take for that line only → compare → decide
features.why: «غلايتسه» flagged with a suggested reading; rule recorded; only l9 re-recorded (12 other takes' ids and audio hashes unchanged); before/after side by side; approving without listening refused; old rejected, new approved; decisions survive reopening.

features.feature: Whether the corrected draft pronunciation actually sounds right
features.why: Needs a human ear. Claude cannot listen; the machine transcript is shown but is not proof.

features.feature: ElevenLabs final pronunciation
features.why: By design: paid generation locked. A draft voice never certifies the final voice.

features.feature: Genuinely different concepts as real images
features.why: 4 scenes × 3–4 techniques rendered by the local engine (timeline, kinetic type, technical drawing, paper-cut, 2.5D parallax, map, keynote).

features.feature: Historical archival photographs
features.why: No licensed archival photos (Gleitze 1927, Borgel, Tavannes, Daily Mail page) are in the project: the concepts show REAL PHOTO NEEDED and cannot be selected. Nothing was invented.

features.feature: Product macro with verified Rolex imagery
features.why: No licensed Rolex photographs available. Shown as blocked; no watch is drawn and labelled Rolex.

features.feature: Paper-cut, technical illustration, timeline, 2.5D
features.why: Rendered; technical drawings carry 'simplified principle — not the maker's engineering drawing' and only draw case, tube, threads, crown, bezel and case back.

features.feature: Supported / needs implementation / paid
features.why: Support matrix on the Art screen: supported, needs real material, prototype, paid tool (AI illustration), needs implementation (e.g. verified 3D, live footage).

features.feature: Compare, full screen, select ≠ approve, request revision, review revision, approve a version, appears in storyboard
features.why: All through the UI; v1 and v2 side by side; approved l9 map v2 is the visual of storyboard scene l9; rejected and withdrawn approvals keep their history.

features.feature: Free-text revision requests
features.why: Structured changes (darker/lighter paper, bigger text, closer, slower) are applied by the system; a free-text note is carried to the art operator but nothing executes it automatically.

features.feature: Storyboard from the approved script, durations from narration, transitions
features.why: 13 scenes + Time Keeper end card; each scene's length = its approved take + fixed lead/tail; status of voice/art per scene.

features.feature: Free/local draft render, playable in the dashboard
features.why: 1080×1920 MP4 rendered locally with the Time Keeper engine; WebM preview plays in the page (project home, Draft, Final gate).

features.feature: Captions, sync, motion, end card, moving hook on Reels
features.why: Captions follow the take's word times; the reviewer's cross-correlation found every voice clip at its intended offset; frame 1 moves (no STATIC_OPENING); the Time Keeper end card closes the film.

features.feature: A professional video
features.why: Consistent, clean and on-brand, but a draft: robotic free voice that is ~20% slower than the brand narrator, no music bed, several typographic scenes, no real photographs, crude 1:10M map coastlines.

features.feature: Independent reviewer finds planted defects with scene, time, evidence, severity, fix
features.why: 14/14 planted defects found in the disposable copy (after two reviewer fixes made during the test); clean draft: one genuine finding.

features.feature: Subjective art judgement (composition, clarity)
features.why: The reviewer's composition/clarity checks are rules (overlap, cut, captions, banner length, palette, holds). Aesthetic judgement came from Claude's own frame-by-frame review and the second agent, not from the tool.

features.feature: Accept → correction task; dismiss keeps history; no automatic change to approved art
features.why: Accepted finding became a task; the fix was made, re-rendered, re-reviewed (finding gone) and the task closed; approved work fingerprint unchanged by review and decisions.

features.feature: Progress dashboard: stage, scenes, timings, ETA rule, blockers, inbox, latest film
features.why: After fixes found in this test (stale blockers, dead run shown as running with an ETA, no inbox, no film on home).

features.feature: Nothing approved just because a file exists
features.why: Files dropped into the project during the UAT changed no status; unit test too.

features.feature: Final plan: exact text, voice, model, billable characters, blockers, the approved draft beside it
features.why: Plan lists the exact provider input per line, voice id, model, settings, seed, characters, and every blocker.

features.feature: Owner authorization required; unauthorized generation refused; zero paid calls
features.why: Authorization and 'Generate now' refused in the UI and by API; refusals logged; no key in the environment; the Studio cannot import the gateway.

features.feature: Budget, single-use approval, reuse of approved takes
features.why: Proved with a MOCK provider in unit tests on this project's real plan: disabled → refused; no/too-small budget → refused; tampered plan → refused; one run (13 mock calls); second run with the same approval refused. Not a test of ElevenLabs.

features.feature: Failure recovery: rejected script, wrong pronunciation, rejected take, rejected/withdrawn art, revision, failed render, refresh, duplicate, interrupted task, reopen after restart, missing media, unauthorized paid call
features.why: Each exercised (UI, or unit test where marked); no approved work lost.

features.feature: Approval synchronisation across sessions
features.why: A change on the phone appears in an open desktop inbox without reload; a conflicting second decision is refused.

features.feature: Studio projects inside the main review dashboard
features.why: The review dashboard links to the Studio ('＋ New video'), but Studio projects are not listed in its project switcher or its Artifact (phone) copy.

separation: Tested for real through the interface: every owner action in stages A–J and the recovery cases (iPhone 13 size, plus desktop checks).
Real but machine-only: word timings and transcripts (faster-whisper), A/V sync by cross-correlation, layout checks. They inform; a person decides.
Done by Claude outside the app (labelled operator input): research, script text, hooks, art brief, revision of free-text notes.
Mocked: the paid provider (ElevenLabs) in unit tests only. No real paid call was made; the gateway stays disabled.

Missing / blocked: licensed photographs (archival, Rolex product); an automatic grammar/dialect checker; Studio projects inside the review dashboard and its phone (Artifact) copy; human listening of the draft corrections.
